purpose: The P31 canon component manifest — the machine-readable contract an agent reads to COMPOSE a face without porting JSX. Consume intent, never raw values. Appearance comes from var(--p31-*) tokens; the shell owns geometry only.
composition_rules: Compose from these components. Never port styled JSX from another app.
The shell owns geometry (position/size/flow). Canon owns appearance (color/surface/radius/shadow/type).
Theming is a value swap at the semantic tier — never fork a component per theme.
The only raw element permitted is an interactive mount (editor/canvas/grid input) — geometry classes only.
If a variant is missing, extend the canon (design-core), never fork in the shell.

GlassPanel.purpose: Surface frame — the container for a face's content.

GlassCard.purpose: Card item in a list — title + metadata.

Button.purpose: Action. Primary for the main verb, ghost for secondary.

MetricBadge.purpose: A single metric — value + label (+ optional icon).

SidebarNav.purpose: Structured navigation rail. The canon owns layout + active state; the consumer supplies items + onNavigate.

SpoonDial.purpose: The 0-5 cognitive-load meter. Wired to the shell store's spoons/setSpoons.

Starfield.purpose: The fullscreen ambient night-sky canvas. Spoon/voltage-aware.

Chameleon.purpose: The theme picker. Owns its trigger + panel + token application. Mount bare — no wrapper.

CrisisOverlay.purpose: The rest-stop at spoons 0. Focus-trapped modal.
